precision: stable formula 160 decimal digits; direct quadrature/difference at 256 decimal digits (>512 bits)
direct_checks: per chunk at h/r=2^-24 and 2^-128, rho/r=2^256, epsilon=half upper bound; w=a0−2^-192,a0,a0+2^-192,r, with difference step 2^-240
baseline: at qb=(r+h)/s check uniform w mean J=1 via piecewise closed-form quadrature for same 2 parameter combinations per chunk
stop: finite all states or first inequality violation or exception in affected chunk; exceptions explicitly retained
threshold: abs(rho*dq log J)<=256; direct rho-scaled errors <1e-80 and derivative errors <1e-25
